summary: GoPro, Inc. filed an 8-K/A to update a prior disclosure on patent litigation with Contour IP Holding LLC (CIPH). The jury initially found one claim infringed (awarding $8.2M in past damages) but invalidated others; the court later granted GoPro's motion for judgment as a matter of law, invalidating the sole remaining valid claim, vacated the damages award, and denied CIPH's motions. GoPro now has no liability, though CIPH may appeal to the Federal Circuit. This is a litigation update, not a special situation transaction.
